_doc: WP-Q1 named light presets (coordinator/Fable 2026-11-05, after the creator's 'historical, epic, rich world' note): Blender Studio's Wing It! rule as data, shared by WP-Q1 (shading), WP-Q4 (the character benchmark) and WP-Q8 (the world kits). Only the key SUN casts a shadow; two colourable rims (rim_a, rim_b) light the cast only (light linking), shadowless, specular <= 0.3; an optional shadowless fill; one world tint per sequence (the ambient light's colour and strength; camera rays still see the look's sky). Rim aims are relative to the camera (elevation, azimuth offset from straight behind the subject); the key's azimuth is world-fixed so a set keeps its light across shots; on a character shot the key turns to front_offset_deg off the camera axis (30-45 degrees, Fable 2026-11-05: a front-biased key reads faces), the set-only shot keeps the world sun. A character shot = a camera focused nearer than style.CHARACTER_SHOT_M (12 m); a world shot with key.world_offset_deg aims the sun per shot from behind the camera's side at that offset (Fable 2026-11-05 22:51 UTC: the E2 hero's sun direction must read in its shadows). Optional sky: tint (HDRI multiplier), horizon (below-horizon haze and a warm band over the horizon), top (gradient sky), horizon_band (height of the band, 0..1 of the up axis), glow (its share at the horizon). Optional key.shadow_filter: the key's shadow filter radius instead of the look's (overcast soft 5, noon hard 1). Optional world_exposure_ev: the view's exposure on a world shot only (a raking sun leaves half the set in shadow). Sun strength 1 = a white surface facing it shows 1.0. Every number is HYP until the creator judges the clips; colours are RGB multipliers, never palette hex.

character_key._doc: WP-Q4's front_key() (character_benchmark.py, the lead close-up rain_lead_cu_v3_front_key_720p.png accepted by Fable 2026-11-05 22:17 UTC) as data: on a close-up the preset's key and fill give way to a warm key 35 degrees off the camera axis and above the eye line (front_key: 0.55 m above the head at 3 m = 10.4 degrees) and a cool shadowless fill opposite at a quarter of its energy; the era preset's rims and world tint stay. Look.character_key turns it on.

golden_hour.feel: low warm sun, a hot orange rim on one side and a cool sky rim on the other, warm-blue air

noon_epic.feel: high bright sun for battle and establishing shots, a warm rim, clear blue sky air

overcast_day.feel: soft cool daylight, gentle rims, grey-blue air: rain, mourning, sieges

interior_hearth.feel: a hall by firelight: warm side key, a fire-orange rim and a cold window rim, deep warm air

night_moon.feel: cool moonlight key, a warm torch rim, deep blue air
